set.body:
Outcome: explain frozen recovery losses and identify a defensible improvement using reproducible numerical evidence.
Scope: separate missing-adjacency coverage, mapping ambiguity and score normalization; retain original campaign unchanged. Synthetic inputs only; no chronology prior, truth-based tuning or participant accuracy claim.
Acceptance: exact decomposition of all 144 packet cases, language score/tie/temperature diagnosis, bounded comparison using an existing semantic channel if available, independent review of conclusions.
Paths: tools/recall-study/organization_diagnosis.py; tools/recall-study/tests/test_organization_diagnosis.py; pipeline/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/pipeline/OrganizationDiagnosisWitness.scala; docs/refactor/evidence/organization-diagnosis-20261013/.
Next: trace current lexical scoring and model availability before choosing implementation changes.
set.title: Investigate organization recovery loss and improvement options
